rationale: The same July 2022 Aerorozvidka statement that Ukrainians were killed by Russian AeroScope users, from the same RFE/RL source.
The same Lancet-3 strike on an abandoned Leopard 2A6 after 8 June 2023, from the same Popular Mechanics source; the chapter copy points to the topic claim.
The same description of the e-points scheme (hits uploaded to Delta, points spent on Brave1 Market), from the same source.
The composite claim restates that a Mavic had lasted six months near Donetsk in late 2022, from the same Euromaidan source.
Gives the payload (four RPG rounds per drone) of the converted agricultural UAVs that the RUSI claim says dropped RPGs.
EW vulnerability of current fixed-wing drones and the pre-2022 Kropyva link to artillery are different subjects.
The chapter claim includes the same Lancet hit on an 82nd Brigade Stryker on 15 August 2023, from the same Kyiv Post source.
One says the R18 drops RKG grenades, the other gives the grenades' penetration and tail fins; related context only.
The loss tally near Huliaipole in January 2023 includes the crashed Matrice described in detail by the other claim, same source.
Both state from the same RUSI report that Orlan-30s laser-designated for Krasnopol in winter–spring 2023; c11 adds more Orlan-30 flights in spring.
Deaths from AeroScope targeting and units moving to non-DJI drones are cause and response, not corroboration of each other.
Lancet airframe weights and the effectiveness of nets against each variant are different quantities.
The account of the 7 June attempt (mines, then drone-spotted artillery fire) is consistent with analyses blaming mines and artillery, partly via the same Guardian source.
The same 2022 capture and dismissal of a Russian Silok by the 128th Brigade, same Militarnyi source; c11_0046_15 carries the quote.
Gives a more precise description of the Army SOS Kropyva app (target mapping, fire missions, drone data for corrections), same Forbes source.
Both name mines, artillery, ATGMs and Ka-52s as what stopped the columns south of Mala Tokmachka on 7–8 June 2023, from overlapping sources.
The incident of five agricultural drones destroying or damaging seven tanks is an instance of the RUSI pattern of night attacks with converted agricultural drones, same report.
The same unit losing three Mavics in two weeks near Huliaipole in January 2023, from the same Euromaidan source; c10 also mentions the crashed Matrice.
Kyiv Post's report that Ukrainian units had bought and assembled big agricultural octocopters since early in the war loosely corroborates their use as bombers in the 2023 counteroffensive.
The same RUSI report of platoon-level jammers and UAV-hijacking arrays in spring 2023.
The target mix and the hit/miss count from the Oryx Lancet list are different measures of the same dataset.
Both describe Kropyva as an Army SOS mapping app on tablets, from the same Forbes source, with different details.
The R18 being at the front since 2019 and being built partly to evade AeroScope are compatible facts that do not corroborate each other.
Volunteers patching firmware to stop AeroScope tracking presupposes that AeroScope locates DJI drones, from a different source.
The same jammed DJI Matrice crashing near Huliaipole in January 2023, from the same Euromaidan source; c10_0027_09 names the Matrice 300 RTK.
Fedorov's letter and DJI's reply are two sides of one exchange; neither corroborates or undermines the other's assertion.
Specifies what the platoon jammers and hijacking arrays did and their density (at least one per platoon), same RUSI report.
Gives the payload (four RPG rounds each) of the converted agricultural drones in RUSI's description.
The composite claim restates the loss of three Mavics in two weeks near Huliaipole in January 2023, from the same Euromaidan source.
A serviceman's Mavic 3 dropping VOG-17s singly or together is consistent with the estimate of two VOG-17s per Mavic 3; the sources overlap.
Deaths from AeroScope targeting and units moving to non-DJI drones are cause and response, not corroboration of each other.
Both state from the same RUSI report that the VDV and Wagner used Strelets in 2022–23.
A later Lancet strike on an abandoned Leopard and the 7–8 June breach attempt are different events.
A Lancet strike on an already abandoned Leopard does not bear on DeepState's count of irrecoverable losses.
Warhead mass and total airframe mass of the Lancet variants are different quantities.
Deaths from AeroScope targeting and Aerorozvidka building the R18 to evade it are related context, not corroboration.
The fall in Excalibur hit rate from 55% to 6% in 2023 under GNSS jamming corroborates the assessment that its accuracy collapsed, same Kyiv Post source.
The Huliaipole loss tally for January 2023 includes the crashed Matrice the other claim describes, same source.
The same unit losing three Mavics in two weeks to Russian EW near Huliaipole in January 2023, same Euromaidan source.
Identical: a Lancet hit an 82nd Brigade Stryker east of Robotyne on 15 August 2023, same Kyiv Post source.
